code-review: failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 没写 productIssue，按它的 physicianImpact 算））
Neither context calls an EHR. Both Post-Round tabs send Copy to EMR through useCopyToEmr, and that calls only copyTextToClipboard: the Capacitor Clipboard on mobile, otherwise navigator.clipboard.writeText, with a hidden-textarea execCommand fallback. A grep of apps/web/src and apps/web/convex for FHIR, HL7, Epic, Cerner, SMART or "EHR" as a whole word finds nothing. In both contexts, marking the encounter complete only saves the app's own record (status set to post-rounded or complete) and writes a usage-analytics row. The in-app export record differs by context. The Hospital tab hands useCopyToEmr a beforeCopy callback that calls logExport("clipboard", 1), so a copy writes the record through api.access.logExport. The Nursing Home tab calls useCopyToEmr(ex.note || "") with no callback, and the file never imports useLogExport, so copying a Nursing Home note writes no export record. The rule says a context without the export record fails. This is a new gap that waits on no open question, so the verdict is fail. I found no "Copy A&P" control in either Post-Round tab, so there was nothing to review for it. The code also predicts problems for the visual layout half: the Nursing Home tab has no Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary card, no Pending Tasks sheet, and its button reads "Mark Visit Complete". A person still has to sign that half off. No recorded gaps or open questions apply.
产品问题（按 physicianImpact）: When a physician copies a Nursing Home note to the EMR, the app keeps no record of that PHI leaving it, while the same copy in Hospital is recorded. Admins reviewing export activity will miss every Nursing Home note copy. / When a nursing home physician copies a note with Copy to EMR, the clipboard copy works, but no export entry is saved in the app's activity log. Admins reviewing who copied which resident's note will not see those copies. Separately, the nursing home note tab does not show Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary.

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S22 「原型一致性（p72_HAIKU）以及「任何地方都不读写 EHR」的审查」 Prototype parity (p72_HAIKU) and 'no EHR read or write anywhere' review

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 Post-Round matches the attached prototype (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html) in design and functionality.（TFA-92595 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T2 Copy is clipboard only: no real EHR read or write happens anywhere.（TFA-92595 AC 3；TFA-92595 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T7 The Note tab shows tomorrow's Pre-Round summary underneath the note.（TFA-92595 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T3 The Billing Suggestion appears on the Note tab, alongside (below) the note.（TFA-92595 AC 6；TFA-92595 How it works 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given The prototype RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html attached to TFA-92595; the app at origin/main e02167f

When Compare Post-Round side by side in both contexts (Ask button, toggle bar, note card, Copy to EMR, Tomorrow's summary, billing card, Mark Encounter Complete, the Pending Tasks sheet); then review the code behind Copy to EMR, Copy A&P and Mark Encounter Complete for any EHR or other external call

Then Layout, labels and behaviour match the prototype in both contexts, including Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary under the note and the billing card below the note; Copy's only effects are a clipboard write and the in-app export record; no EHR endpoint, SDK or credential anywhere

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Human side-by-side and code review; each mismatch quoted with the screen or file/line. 'Underneath' (T7) and 'below the note' (T3) are judged here because the lane-A specs only check that the heading and the card are visible. The automated network evidence for the copy path is S02 a7 (Q10)

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-17.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 failed 改成 broken。

问题分类：票没到 ready for qa · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92595 in progress

养老院的 Copy to EMR 不写 app 内导出记录（医院的会写）；从代码看，养老院 Post-Round 也没有原型里的明日 Pre-Round 摘要和 Pending Tasks 弹窗；任何地方都没有 EHR 调用。

Copying a Nursing Home note to EMR writes no in-app export record, while the Hospital copy does. The code also suggests the Nursing Home Post-Round lacks the prototype's Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary and Pending Tasks sheet. There is no EHR call anywhere.

依据：Allure ab13d5d0, code-review failed. The NH PostRoundTab calls useCopyToEmr with no logExport callback. All of S22's requirements (T1/T2/T3/T7) are gated 'blocked: TFA-92595 in progress'. The missing NH export record is a new finding, not in the dev report or ledger. The layout half still needs a person's sign-off.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；辅助：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：code-review。

UAT item: TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-17/S22

Prototype parity (p72_HAIKU) and 'no EHR read or write anywhere' review

Tickets: TFA-92595 Post-Round Review & Completion (in progress)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 没写 productIssue，按它的 physicianImpact 算））。

Detail:

Neither context calls an EHR. Both Post-Round tabs send Copy to EMR through useCopyToEmr, and that calls only copyTextToClipboard: the Capacitor Clipboard on mobile, otherwise navigator.clipboard.writeText, with a hidden-textarea execCommand fallback. A grep of apps/web/src and apps/web/convex for FHIR, HL7, Epic, Cerner, SMART or "EHR" as a whole word finds nothing. In both contexts, marking the encounter complete only saves the app's own record (status set to post-rounded or complete) and writes a usage-analytics row. The in-app export record differs by context. The Hospital tab hands useCopyToEmr a beforeCopy callback that calls logExport("clipboard", 1), so a copy writes the record through api.access.logExport. The Nursing Home tab calls useCopyToEmr(ex.note || "") with no callback, and the file never imports useLogExport, so copying a Nursing Home note writes no export record. The rule says a context without the export record fails. This is a new gap that waits on no open question, so the verdict is fail. I found no "Copy A&P" control in either Post-Round tab, so there was nothing to review for it. The code also predicts problems for the visual layout half: the Nursing Home tab has no Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary card, no Pending Tasks sheet, and its button reads "Mark Visit Complete". A person still has to sign that half off. No recorded gaps or open questions apply.

产品问题（按 physicianImpact）：lane 没写 productIssue，失败·产品按它的 physicianImpact 算（全文见下）。

新发现（newFindings）：

  • apps/web/src/features/snf/patient/PostRoundTab.tsx:59: Nursing Home Post-Round: Copy to EMR passes no beforeCopy callback and the file never imports useLogExport, so copying the note writes no in-app export record.
  • apps/web/src/features/snf/patient/PostRoundTab.tsx:59: The Nursing Home Post-Round Copy to EMR passes no beforeCopy callback, so no in-app export record is written. Copy has only one of the two required effects here.
  • apps/web/src/features/snf/patient/PostRoundTab.tsx:28: The Nursing Home Post-Round imports only useRecordUsage from @/data, not useLogExport. Nothing in this tab logs an export.

和 Then 不一致（againstThen）：

  • apps/web/src/features/snf/patient/PostRoundTab.tsx:355: The Nursing Home Post-Round button is labelled 'Mark Visit Complete', not 'Mark Encounter Complete'. The tab has no TomorrowPreRoundSummaryCard and no Pending Tasks sheet, which predicts a layout mismatch with p72 in that context.
  • apps/web/src/features/snf/patient/PostRoundTab.tsx:339: The Nursing Home Post-Round never renders a Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary under the note. Only the BillingCard follows the note. The code predicts that the parity check fails for T7 in the Nursing Home context. The label also differs: 'Mark Visit Complete' instead of 'Mark Encounter Complete'.

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • I found no 'Copy A&P' control in either Post-Round tab at e02167f. Is it expected somewhere, perhaps the A&P Only template, or does the question's wording come from an earlier design?
  • Should the Nursing Home tab carry Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary and the Pending Tasks sheet like the Hospital tab? The code leaves them out, so the visual half will probably fail there.
  • The scenario names a 'Copy A&P' action, but there is no such button or handler in apps/web/src at e02167f. Should it exist (prototype parity), or does the scenario mean something else?
  • Is the missing export record on the Nursing Home Copy intended, for example as an audit scope limited to hospital panels? The pass/fail rule treats it as a fail.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • layout parity vs p72 (VISUAL (a person signs off))
  • Visual side-by-side layout, labels and behaviour against p72 in both contexts (a person signs off)
  • Runtime network evidence that copying makes no external call (S02 a7, Q10)
  • Grep of the static bundle for EHR terms (static lane, ehrSource / ehrBundle)
  • Visual layout and label parity with RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html in both contexts (person sign-off).
  • Runtime network behaviour of the copy path (S02 a7, Q10).

对医生的影响（physicianImpact）：When a physician copies a Nursing Home note to the EMR, the app keeps no record of that PHI leaving it, while the same copy in Hospital is recorded. Admins reviewing export activity will miss every Nursing Home note copy. / When a nursing home physician copies a note with Copy to EMR, the clipboard copy works, but no export entry is saved in the app's activity log. Admins reviewing who copied which resident's note will not see those copies. Separately, the nursing home note tab does not show Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary.

审查结论（verdict）：fail

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
